subject: Right, Natal used in a Burnout game shocker, lol
author: SUFFUR
body:
Taken from the Time magazine talking about Natal,

http://www.time.com/time/arts/article/0,8599,1902208,00.html

Actual paragraph

"Kipman also showed me a version of Burnout that had been set up to work with Project Natal. Burnout is a serious game, not just a tech demo — it's a polished, fast-paced racing game with high-end graphics, and I happen to have played a lot of it. With Project Natal, instead of using a joystick, you steer by holding your hands up in the air like you're gripping a steering wheel. To hit the gas, you move your foot forward along the floor. To brake, you move it back. To trigger the turbo boost, you do a gear-shifting, fist-pumping movement with your right arm. Awesome."

So may be were Mr Ward has been working away too, seems like a cool concept.

http://www.gametrailers.com/video/e3-09-apb/50049?type=wmv and sorry but age sensative (sp) but it looks like it going to be PC and not Xbox 360 as well, boo, but we will see?

subject: The Sony show
author: SUFFUR
body:
Thus good, not as good as Ms but good.

The Motion controller was a rush job, but fun game play, they lost sleep trying to do catch up.

I lover Modnation Racer, twus awesum to the max, lol.

They put on a good show considering the leaks, some very pretty games, the new Ico was mad as a bag of spiders but looked amazing.

I liked the look of MAG but could not tell if the guy was shooting someone or not it seems to staged normall a battle would mean carnage and destruction like Drake's 2, whcih was nice, though it reminded me of COD with the chopper strick, and in all cases the first shot should have keelled him, lol.

PSP Go was nice, and GT5 looked more real again and has done since GT 3 lol, but it will get realer with every incarnation.

There was the usual bread and butter sale pitch, which MS did not really do, so did Nintendo, which was meh! except Metanoid (sp).

The usual game fodder, GOW3, err GT5, err, LBP, and stuff for the PSP, too, but they advertized all the games out this year and next and not just exclusives, so saved some money for MS, and on avery pretty and huge screen, lol.

There must have been something else but forgot as it went on too long, but it was good not great even with the loose lips out there.

MS for the win, Sony, then Nintendo, who looked lost but are still rich, lol, becuase we love the Wii and the 3 DS's etc.

Patience is something I taught myself, so I never know when it's going to run out? Now thats over lets see what comes out from the wood work that is the free press, lol.

But another good experience but fun to share with  Gav on MSN, lol, can't put the chat up due to Terms and Condition of Life let alone this site or any site, lol. Till next year then, maybe I should go? Donations to Xandu and Zombie, for send Suf to E3 2010, lol.
